quality_note: Eleven eastern margin tick rules could not be distinguished reliably in native-resolution crops and were excluded with reasons recorded in the fit report. The fit uses 28 measured controls and 19 separate checks; original fit/check assignments were preserved.

frame_stroke_width_reason: Native crop corners show dense hill shading and colored boundaries touching the western inner rule, plus map ink at the southeast southern rule. Cap inward stroke expansion at two pixels to avoid clipping those adjoining features.
